_comment: SEED-ROUND V2 ignition rung (docs/SPEC_eq34_seed_round.md §7) — the pinaudit
P1  estimability spectrum IDENTICAL to the audit rung (λmax ≈ 1.19e5,
n_below 1 = declared_dim, L2W direction ≈ 1.67e-04) — targets cannot
move eigenvalues; a moved spectrum means a second variable is loose.
P2  SH gate NEVER engages; a00 in band from epoch 1, settling toward the
rung-4 ≈ 31.5 TECU; ≥ 18/19 emitted (A4 skips allowed).  The audit rung
without seed-round read a00 −18780 at epoch 1 and withheld 19/19.
P3  pin audit still COMPLETE (1558 = 19×82 declared/folded/landed per
signal) — seed-round changes TARGETS, never count or placement.
P4  seed-round max |pin innovation| ≤ 0.123 m (λ_L2W/2) and ~0 target
steps; ~164 seed pins per epoch (82 × 2 signals), all fold-DEFERRED at
epoch 1 (no states exist at the first election), election-side after.
V4  the leveling carry WARMS (emitted epochs ⇒ stash ⇒ carry_warm) — the
degrade-during-withhold deadlock broken at the root.
